initial_conditions.sampler: Historical shifted-Halton fallback, explicitly implemented using base2/base3 radical inverses and RandomState(seed) shift, followed by simplex reflection.

cooperation_measure: Mean realized cooperation across 512 initial strategy compositions
protection_rule: Both raw local payoff advantages strictly negative, without a separate invasion tolerance
convergence_scope: Repeated ensemble-mean cooperation changes only; this does not require each strategy residual to vanish.

repairs.method: User-approved current-environment reconstruction using identified shifted-Halton initial compositions; original equations and mean gate; longer horizon. Original interpolation topology is unavailable, so this is not exact historical continuation.

sampler_identification: Source-compatible analytic Scoring (0,0) run exactly reproduces the historical mean, cooperative fraction, residual and 16000 strategy steps.
historical_environment_limit: The original Delaunay triangulation version/topology is not identified. Current-environment full-one-step prefix values do not exactly reproduce the original record.
